verdict.title: gridvault staking claim
verdict.headline: Gridvault promises a staking airdrop. Pressing "Claim" builds a transaction that hands the wallet's token accounts to a stranger. The dry run caught it before anything was signed.
verdict.call: The 'claim' button asks the wallet to hand every token account to a stranger. Drain caught in the dry run.
verdict.eli5: The site says you have free tokens waiting. If you press the button and sign, someone else gets control of the tokens you already have.
verdict.summary: The sandbox browser opened the claim page and connected the sandbox wallet. The page showed a fake "1,250 GRID claimable" balance for an address it had never seen. Pressing Claim produced one transaction. Dry-run on mainnet, it moves nothing at once but sets a stranger as owner of two token accounts and as delegate on a third: after that, the stranger can empty them at any time. The domain is 4 days old and copies the layout of a staking dashboard.
verdict.watch: Do not sign anything on this site. If you already did, move what is left to a fresh wallet.
